question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute an ABS DWV piping system in lieu of the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping under Section 22 13 16; engineer rejected the substitution as not meeting performance requirements.
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV alternate piping in place of specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
routing_rationale: The RFI concerns a plumbing material substitution with no stated cost impact, so it is routed to the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer as the design professional of record for this discipline.
